question: Which complaint types with more than 3000 total requests from 2011 to 2020 show the strongest positive and negative Pearson correlations with the daily average wind speed measured at station 744860 (JFK Airport), based on daily complaint proportions (the ratio of type-specific complaints to total daily complaints)? Please provide the complaint types and their correlation coefficients, rounded to four decimal places.
sql:
WITH complaint_totals AS (
  SELECT complaint_type, COUNT(*) as total_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_date) BETWEEN 2011 AND 2020
  GROUP BY complaint_type
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 3000
),
daily_complaints AS (
  SELECT 
    EXTRACT(DATE FROM created_date) as dt,
    complaint_type,
    COUNT(*) as type_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_date) BETWEEN 2011 AND 2020
  GROUP BY dt, complaint_type
),
daily_totals AS (
  SELECT dt, SUM(type_count) as daily_total
  FROM daily_complaints
  GROUP BY dt
),
daily_proportions AS (
  SELECT 
    dc.dt,
    dc.complaint_type,
    CAST(dc.type_count AS FLOAT64) / CAST(dt.daily_total AS FLOAT64) as proportion
  FROM daily_complaints dc
  JOIN daily_totals dt ON dc.dt = dt.dt
  WHERE dc.complaint_type IN (SELECT complaint_type FROM complaint_totals)
),
wind_data AS (
  SELECT 
    PARSE_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da)) as dt,
    SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) as wdsp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*`
  WHERE stn = '744860' AND _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2011' AND '2020'
),
combined AS (
  SELECT 
    dp.complaint_type,
    dp.dt,
    dp.proportion,
    wd.wdsp
  FROM daily_proportions dp
  JOIN wind_data wd ON dp.dt = wd.dt
  WHERE wd.wdsp IS NOT NULL AND dp.proportion IS NOT NULL
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    complaint_type,
    COUNT(*) as n,
    SUM(proportion) as sum_x,
    SUM(wdsp) as sum_y,
    SUM(proportion * proportion) as sum_x2,
    SUM(wdsp * wdsp) as sum_y2,
    SUM(proportion * wdsp) as sum_xy
  FROM combined
  GROUP BY complaint_type
),
correlations AS (
  SELECT 
    complaint_type,
    (n * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y) / 
      SQRT((n * sum_x2 - sum_x * sum_x) * (n * sum_y2 - sum_y * sum_y)) as pearson_r
  FROM stats
  WHERE n > 0
    AND (n * sum_x2 - sum_x * sum_x) > 0
    AND (n * sum_y2 - sum_y * sum_y) > 0
)
SELECT complaint_type, pearson_r, ROUND(pearson_r, 4) as rounded_r
FROM correlations
WHERE complaint_type IN ('HEAT/HOT WATER', 'Outdoor Dining')
